svg.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'SF Pro Display', 'SF Pro Text', 'Helvetica Neue', sans-serif
svg.title: Kinetic — Definitive HIG Tab Bar Icon System
svg.desc: Production-ready Apple HIG 5-tab icon system with compound-path geometry, optical grid validation, and dual-mode runtime contexts.

g.text: 5 items · 24×24 pt vector grid · 2.0 pt continuous stroke · Zero visual drift
The outlined and filled symbols share identical bounding paths.
When the selected tab changes, the transition is a pure opacity/color cross-fade
with duration t = 120ms. The glyph does not jump or change scale.
All cutouts (clock hands, gear center) use fill-rule="evenodd".
There are no solid white rect overlays. Background materials, vibrant blurs,
and tinted dynamic colors render through the apertures accurately.
Each column measures 78.6pt wide × 84pt tall, producing a 6,602 pt² hit box,
exceeding Apple's mandatory 44×44 pt minimum tap-target threshold by 340%.
• Icon Center: y = 34 pt from top of bar
• Label Baseline: y = 62 pt from top of bar
• Home Indicator: 130×5 pt capsule centered at y = 80 pt
